summary: Solid shared category rail with overflow-menu web UX and strong unit tests, but PR manual testing and inherited validation recipe are stale after the post-review redesign that removed horizontal scroll and FilterSelect.

comments.body:
This keyboard test assumes exactly two Tab stops before the Crypto pill receives focus. If another focusable element is inserted above the rail (e.g. balance actions gain a new control), the test will fail even when keyboard navigation still works.

Consider focusing the pill directly (`pill.focus()`) before `{Enter}`, or tabbing until `document.activeElement` matches the crypto pill test id.

The implementation intentionally avoids horizontal scroll (overflow menu instead), which addresses geositta's feedback. The PR description and manual testing steps still tell reviewers to confirm horizontal scrolling — please update those docs so QA and future recipe runs target this behavior (narrow window → More menu) rather than `overflow-x-auto`.

Manual testing step 4 still says the filter dropdown should read Crypto after navigation. This page now uses `PerpsCategoryRail` with `testId="market-list-categories"` and no `FilterSelect`. Update the PR testing steps (and any validation recipe) to assert the active Crypto pill on the rail instead of `filter-select-button`.
